subject: EdgeWorks POC: residency, erase guarantees and training-warranty details
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@edgeworks.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgeworks.io
Date: 2028-07-29T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Clarification on data residency & training warranty for upcoming POC

Hi Jordan,

We're wrapping up internal approval for the POC and legal has one outstanding clarification: your public materials say "we don't train on customer data" — can you confirm exactly what that covers for the hosted POC? Specifically we need answers for:

- Whether customer content (prompts/responses) is ever used to fine-tune or update underlying models, either automatically or manually.
- Retention windows for request/response logs, KV caches, and any debug snapshots or traces.
- How backups/snapshots are handled (are they retained offsite? for how long?).
- For Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) what access Redwood employees retain to customer content — is there any ingestion into Redwood systems for diagnostics?

We also prefer contractual language stating a "no model training" warranty plus a short carve‑out for maintenance/debugging if absolutely necessary. I've attached our security questionnaire for reference. Can your compliance team provide a short, plain-language answer we can include in our SOW?

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Security
EdgeWorks, Inc.

Attachment: edgeworks-security-q-2028.pdf

Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Mina (Security & Compliance) and Connor (Product/Runtime). Mina — can you draft a concise response and a suggested contractual sentence for the SOW? Connor — can you add any infra-level details re: KV cache retention and debug snapshot lifecycle.

I'll coordinate a 30min call tomorrow if that helps.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@edgeworks.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on data residency & training warranty for upcoming POC

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Below is a concise set of assurances and the operational nuances so your legal and security teams have context. I kept this plain-language and added a short suggested contractual clause that we can include in the SOW.

High-level commitment (short answer)
- Redwood does not use customer-provided content from paid accounts or active POCs to train or update our foundation models. Customer content is not routed into model-training pipelines or used for supervised fine-tuning without explicit contractual opt-in.

Operational nuances (important details)
- Telemetry and aggregated metrics: We collect non-content telemetry (latency, error rates, token counts) for service health and product improvements. These telemetry streams are aggregated and cannot be reverse-engineered into customer prompts or responses.
- Request/response logs: For hosted deployments we retain full request/response logs to support debugging and SLOs. Default retention: 30 days. We can contractually shorten this retention window for the POC or enterprise customers on request.
- KV cache: The KV cache used for session acceleration is ephemeral. By default entries are TTL'd and evicted within 24 hours after session inactivity; the cache is not persisted to long-term backup storage. If a customer requires stricter behavior (immediate eviction), we can configure the service to tombstone session keys on session end.
- Debug snapshots & traces: Engineers occasionally capture debug snapshots (model state + traces) to triage incidents. These are created only with engineering approval, access-controlled, and by default retained for a maximum of 14 days before permanent deletion. We can exclude snapshots entirely for sensitive workloads.
- Backups and snapshots: Persistent backups of configuration and infra metadata are retained separately from customer content. Customer content is not included in long-term backup archives unless explicitly configured (e.g., for on-prem full-state backups). For hosted customers, backups that may contain limited request/metadata are retained for 90 days for recovery purposes; we can reduce or eliminate backups via contractual terms for enterprise customers.
- Private (VPC/on‑prem) deployments: For Redwood Private where customer runs the inference runtime in their VPC or on-prem hardware, customer content stays in customer infrastructure. The Redwood control plane only receives metadata needed for orchestration and does not ingest full prompts/responses unless the customer opts into telemetry. On-prem packages can be delivered with an option for zero-telemetry.

Evidence and audits
- We include these commitments in our SOC 2 documentation and can provide exportable logs and retention settings for your auditors. We also offer a "no-model-training" attestation for inclusion in procurement.

Suggested short contractual clause (plain-language)
- "No Model Training Warranty: Redwood Inference warrants that, except with Customer's prior written consent, Redwood will not use Customer Content (including prompts, completions, attachments, and related metadata) to train, fine-tune, or improve any machine learning model or foundation model. Redwood may retain aggregated, non-identifiable telemetry for service improvement."

Example carve-outs and optional language
- "Operational Debugging Exception (limited): Redwood may create temporary debug artifacts solely to investigate incidents. Such artifacts will be access‑controlled and deleted within 14 days, unless Customer approves extended retention in writing"

Attachments: I've attached our one‑page "Redwood data commitments" PDF which summarizes the points above for procurement-friendly inclusion.

If EdgeWorks prefers, we can offer a short addendum that sets retention to 7 days for request/response logs during the POC and disallows debug snapshot creation unless explicitly requested.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-data-commitments-2028.pdf

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@edgeworks.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, procurement@edgeworks.io, legal@edgeworks.io
Date: 2028-07-29T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on data residency & training warranty for upcoming POC

Mina — this is very helpful, thank you. A few follow-ups from legal/procurement:

1) Please add a one-line explicit carve-out that "Redwood will not use Customer Content for model training even for aggregated model-testing datasets." We want to be explicit that aggregated sets are excluded unless we opt-in.
2) Procurement asks for POC defaults: can you confirm you will set request/response retention to 7 days and disable debug snapshot creation for the POC by default? We'll add the SOW language accordingly.
3) Legal also wants to know if KV-cache tombstoning on session end can be guaranteed for the POC. If yes, please confirm technical mechanism and any impact to latency.

We've attached our redline template — we'd appreciate a one-page addendum we can sign quickly.

Thanks,
Olivia

Attachment: edgeworks-security-q-2028.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@edgeworks.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on data residency & training warranty for upcoming POC

Olivia — great, glad that helps. Mina and Connor confirm: we can set the POC defaults to 7-day request/response retention, disable debug snapshot creation for the POC, and enable immediate KV-cache tombstoning on session end. Connor notes this tombstoning option may add a very small cold-start latency on sessions that would have otherwise benefited from warm cache; we'll document the expected delta for your engineers.

I'll upload a one-page addendum to the HubSpot deal and share a DocuSign link by EOD. Do you want a quick 20-minute call today to walk procurement/legal through the wording?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
